Alien Swarm is supported by CGS. Sadly no events will be hosted on Alien Swarm. Alien Swarm is a top down, shooter with very smooth graphics and good mechanics. Its fun to play with friends and focuses. On its MultiPlayer the games VERY good and its a free game too. Which is amazing! I rate Alien Swarm 8/10.

CGS Supported

[h1]Awesome co-op game! For free![/h1]
No DLC, no free2play rip-off, just plain free!

Made by Valve.
(You know, the guys who got this thing going called 'Steam'... Rings a bell? No? Ever heard of Half-Life, Team Fortress, Counterstrike, Left 4 Dead, Portal, DotA 2? You're kidding me, of course you know Valve!)

The game used to be a famous Unreal Tournament 2004 total conversion mod. Then Valve hired those devs to remake their game as a stand alone title in Source Engine.


Replay value:

The game is very open towards modding and community created content. Valve has released an SDK, the 'Alien Swarm Authoring Tools' for that purpose. This kinda makes up for the official campaign having only 7 missions, which might seem not too many but...

...For a co-op game the skill cap is pleasantly high and every mission wants to be perfectly mastered and be played over and over, until you got it right and feel safe to try it to a harder difficulty.
There are some pretty experienced guys out there who can teach you some impressive ways to go about things just by watching them finish, solo, after you and the rest of your team died an early death.

What also adds a bit of replay value is this: Once you grow tired of your unlocked arsenal and have reached level 27, you can get promoted. After that you're back at level 1 and all your previously unlocked gear wants to be unlocked again. Every such promotion earns you a medal that serves as an 'experience indicator' and nothing else. I like it though and find it rather tragic that there is currently a maximum of only 6 medals. So you can't grow your epeen any longer after that :(

On a final note, a few most obvious newbie tips for you:

1) Watch your friendly fire! If you're too annoying with your autogun, your medic might just decide to finish you once you come running for help.
2) Learn your secondary weapon modes! The flamer comes with a built-in fire extinguisher, you know. If you set a teammate on fire, at least be polite and put it out.
3) Stay together! You don't stand a chance on your own until you're more experienced.

That's it from me! Now go get it, it's free!

10/10 - Would get TK'ed again... and again and again and again and again.
[h1]That I was looking for! Excellent coop, aliens, many weapons, survival and of course free to play.[/h1]
Its free and fun to play with friends. Too bad there aren't any more levels.
